sources.title: Coding Agent Index v1.5 Methodology
sources.accessAndReuse: Methodology reference only; no composite cost, token, or timing values are re-used.
notes: DeepSWE is 113 tasks; each per-benchmark score averages pass@1 across three attempts per task.

Suite efficiency metrics pool task-attempt cost, input/cache/cache-write/reasoning/output tokens, and execution time across DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0, and SWE-Atlas-QnA; per-benchmark allocations are not reported.

sources.title: DeepSWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Original, Long-Horizon Engineering Tasks
sources.accessAndReuse: PDF inspected; retain score facts, metric definitions, and printed-page locators only; no task, solution, or trajectory content copied.
notes: The paper reports 16 configurations on its full 113-task corpus, but names no benchmark version; all remain version-unknown and are not forced into v1.1.
pass@1 is an equal-task-weighted mean of per-task pass fractions; pass@4 is the fraction solved by at least one of up to four attempts.
Only numerically stated CI bounds are transcribed; unlabelled Figure 8 per-trial costs/tokens/time were not digitized.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Fireworks: Astra-level DeepSWE at 1/15th the cost
sources.accessAndReuse: Attributed source-reported score and Cost/Task facts only; no article content or assets copied.
notes: The post says Fireworks evaluated DeepSWE and reports run-to-run variation, so its four rows are retained as separate Fireworks source observations; benchmark version, harness, task count, and run identity remain unknown.
GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Claude Opus 5 scores round to current v1.1 feed observations but are not merged; Fireworks Cost/Task values remain scoped only to the Fireworks report.
Cost aggregation and billing basis are unspecified. Direct costs are retained as reported, not normalized as a mean/median cost metric; no token or time values are derived.
